picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5% this year would push the Federal Reserve toward tighter policy and erode real wages and bond returns.

picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.2% in November?
picks.why: A November jobless rate above 4.2% would signal a cooling labor market and shift expectations for Federal Reserve rate cuts.

picks.question: Will real GDP increase by more than 1.5% in Q4 2026?
picks.why: Fourth-quarter growth above 1.5% would show the U.S. economy kept expanding through year-end despite elevated inflation.

picks.question: OpenAI IPO closing market cap above $1.2T?
picks.why: OpenAI's IPO valuation will test whether investor enthusiasm for AI holds up in public markets at trillion-dollar scale.

picks.question: Will a Chinese company have one of the top 3 AI models by December 31?
picks.why: A Chinese lab among the top three AI models would suggest export controls have not secured a durable U.S. lead.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which firm leads frontier AI shapes where capital, talent, and cloud revenue concentrate across the technology sector.
